chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Musa ibn al-Hasan, from al-Haytham al-Nahdi, raising it, said:
A man complained to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) of al-ubnah (anal fissure/hemorrhoids), so Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) wiped upon his back, and a red worm dropped from him, so he was cured.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Al-Ubna and how was it cured by the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the Imam’s authority in physical healing (*al-ubnah*, often interpreted as hemorrhoids or anal fissures) through a tactile miracle where a red worm was expelled after Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) wiped the man's back. It serves as a key example of the Imams' divine knowledge of the unseen (*ghayb*) and their ability to effect cure through simple physical contact, reinforcing their status as the primary sources of spiritual and physical remedy for the Shia community.
